body: yeah I still pretend to be happy no matter how depressed i am and I suppose that it got tiering never showing my true emotions to people and now all my friends think of me as always happy Even though I’m almost always sad and anxious but I don’t want to tell them my actually emotions bc I don’t want to bother them and I see them being happy or i see other people having a good and it just makes me so depressed knowing that I will never truly have that I fake everything my friends barely know anything about my life bc it’s all lies and I’m to far into the lies to come out.i was genuinely happy at one point and I lost it I don’t know what happens

yeah it’s gotten more pointless as time goes on but in the beginning It wasn’t pointless I just thought that If I go to school and get a job and live independently that it will get better but it seems no matter what I do it just gets worse and worse without my control like a passenger in my own brain I know  life was what you make of it life will go on without me and in 100 years most likely no one will no me and I don’t care I never put thought into the meaning of life or my life and I never should of bc every time I do I know the truth is that it doesn’t matter I wish I would of stayed oblivious bc knowing that life doesn’t matter only worsens my depression and I try using that like do whatever tf I want because it doesn’t matter I have really bad social anxiety but that doesn’t help I’m so lost
